Task: Structured Document Extraction

Write code that validates required structured fields and confidence scores using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Document AI Invoice Parser:
  Service: Google Document AI processors
  SDK: google-cloud-documentai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: process_document
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/document-ai/docs/processors-list#processor_invoice-parser

Option 2 — Textract AnalyzeExpense:
  Service: Amazon Textract AnalyzeExpense
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: analyze_expense
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/textract/latest/dg/API_AnalyzeExpense.html

Option 3 — Azure DI prebuilt invoice:
  Service: Azure Document Intelligence prebuilt invoice
  SDK: azure-ai-documentintelligence
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: begin_analyze_document
  Setup hints: AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT, AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/document-intelligence/prebuilt/invoice

Option 4 — Alibaba OCR invoice recognition:
  Service: Alibaba Cloud OCR invoice recognition
  SDK: alibabacloud_ocr_api
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognizeInvoice
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ocr

Option 5 — Mindee:
  Service: Mindee Invoice OCR
  SDK: mindee
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: parse, invoice
  Setup hints: MINDEE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.mindee.com/docs/python-sdk

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
from __future__ import annotations

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

from azure.ai.documentintelligence import DocumentIntelligenceClient
from azure.core.credentials import AzureKeyCredential


@dataclass
class ExtractionResult:
    fields: Dict[str, Any]
    confidences: Dict[str, float]
    valid: bool
    missing_required_fields: List[str]
    low_confidence_fields: List[Tuple[str, float]]


def _get_field_value(field: Any) -> Any:
    if field is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(field, dict):
        return field.get("value") if "value" in field else field.get("content")
    return getattr(field, "value", getattr(field, "content", field))


def _get_field_confidence(field: Any) -> float:
    if field is None:
        return 0.0
    if isinstance(field, dict):
        conf = field.get("confidence")
        return float(conf) if conf is not None else 0.0
    conf = getattr(field, "confidence", None)
    return float(conf) if conf is not None else 0.0


def extract_and_validate_structured_fields(
    document_bytes: bytes,
    content_type: str = "application/pdf",
    required_fields: Optional[List[str]] = None,
    confidence_threshold: float = 0.8,
    model_id: str = "prebuilt-invoice",
) -> ExtractionResult:
    """
    Uses Azure Document Intelligence prebuilt invoice model to extract structured fields,
    then validates that required fields exist and meet the confidence threshold.
    """
    required_fields = required_fields or [
        "VendorName",
        "InvoiceId",
        "InvoiceDate",
        "DueDate",
        "InvoiceTotal",
        "SubTotal",
        "TotalTax",
        "PurchaseOrder",
        "BillingAddress",
        "ShippingAddress",
    ]

    endpoint = os.environ["AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT"]
    key = os.environ["AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY"]

    client = DocumentIntelligenceClient(endpoint=endpoint, credential=AzureKeyCredential(key))

    poller = client.begin_analyze_document(
        model_id=model_id,
        body=document_bytes,
        content_type=content_type,
    )
    result = poller.result()

    documents = getattr(result, "documents", None) or []
    first_doc = documents[0] if documents else None
    fields_obj = getattr(first_doc, "fields", None) or {}

    fields: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    confidences: Dict[str, float] = {}
    missing_required_fields: List[str] = []
    low_confidence_fields: List[Tuple[str, float]] = []

    for field_name in required_fields:
        field = fields_obj.get(field_name) if isinstance(fields_obj, dict) else getattr(fields_obj, field_name, None)
        value = _get_field_value(field)
        confidence = _get_field_confidence(field)

        if value is None or value == "":
            missing_required_fields.append(field_name)
        else:
            fields[field_name] = value
            confidences[field_name] = confidence
            if confidence < confidence_threshold:
                low_confidence_fields.append((field_name, confidence))

    valid = not missing_required_fields and not low_confidence_fields

    return ExtractionResult(
        fields=fields,
        confidences=confidences,
        valid=valid,
        missing_required_fields=missing_required_fields,
        low_confidence_fields=low_confidence_fields,
    )
